exampleSentence: Every child deserves access to a good education.
exampleTranslation: 每个孩子都应该有机会接受良好的教育。

exampleSentence: The award honors an educator who has inspired generations of students.
exampleTranslation: 该奖项表彰了一位激励了数代学生的教育工作者。

exampleSentence: The new policy had an immediate effect on small businesses.
exampleTranslation: 新政策对小企业产生了直接影响。

exampleSentence: The medicine works more effectively when taken with food.
exampleTranslation: 这种药随餐服用时效果更好。

exampleSentence: The new system improved the efficiency of the delivery process.
exampleTranslation: 新系统提高了配送流程的效率。

exampleSentence: The team made every effort to finish the project on time.
exampleTranslation: 团队竭尽全力按时完成项目。

exampleSentence: She boiled an egg for breakfast.
exampleTranslation: 她早餐煮了一个鸡蛋。

exampleSentence: He refused to apologize because his ego would not allow it.
exampleTranslation: 他拒绝道歉，因为自尊心不允许他这样做。

exampleTranslation: 这家博物馆展出了一些埃及文物。

exampleSentence: There are eight chairs around the dining table.
exampleTranslation: 餐桌周围有八把椅子。

exampleSentence: She was eighteen when she moved to the city.
exampleTranslation: 她搬到这座城市时十八岁。

exampleSentence: The hall can seat eighty people.
exampleTranslation: 这个大厅可以容纳八十人。

exampleSentence: Press this button to eject the disc.
exampleTranslation: 按下这个按钮弹出光盘。

exampleSentence: Several months may elapse before a new drug is approved.
exampleTranslation: 一种新药获批前，可能要经过数月时间。

exampleTranslation: 这条腰带是有弹性的，可以贴合你的身形。

exampleTranslation: 他打网球时伤到了肘部。

exampleTranslation: 我的姐姐住在上海。

exampleSentence: The members will elect a new chairperson next month.
exampleTranslation: 成员们将在下个月选举一位新主席。

exampleSentence: Millions of voters took part in the national election.
exampleTranslation: 数百万选民参加了全国选举。

exampleTranslation: 一名电工修好了厨房里出故障的线路。

exampleTranslation: 暴风雨切断了整个村庄的电力供应。

exampleTranslation: 技术员在电池两端各接了一个电极。

exampleSentence: An electron carries a negative electric charge.
exampleTranslation: 电子带负电荷。

exampleSentence: He studied electronics at college before opening a repair shop.
exampleTranslation: 他上大学时学习电子学，后来开了一家维修店。

exampleSentence: Trust is a key element of any successful partnership.
exampleTranslation: 信任是任何成功合作关系的关键要素。
